name: UDM-SE
title: Dream Machine Special Edition
summary: 1U rack Cloud Gateway: 10G SFP+ WAN/LAN, 8-port PoE switch, 3.5in NVR bay, runs all UniFi apps.

extra.poe_port_split: specs give per-port caps (PoE 15.4W / PoE+ 30W) and 180W budget but not how many of ports 1-8 are PoE vs PoE+

gotchas: The 8 LAN ports are 1GbE; only one 2.5GbE RJ45 (default WAN) — multi-gig APs/NAS need a downstream switch such as USW-Pro-Max-16 or USW-Pro-XG.
IDS/IPS tops out at 3.5 Gbps — with a 5-10G ISP and IPS on, routing is capped well below the 10G SFP+ WAN.
Single 3.5" NVR bay, no RAID: recording is limited to ~8 4K cameras with no drive redundancy — offload Protect to a UNVR/UNVR-Pro for larger fleets.
No built-in WiFi — budget for APs (e.g. U7 Pro); UDR-5G-Max/Dream Router line is the all-in-one alternative.
Shadow Mode HA requires a second UDM-SE; DC backup requires a USP-RPS.
best_for: SMB/prosumer rack with 1-10G WAN wanting one box for gateway + Protect
not_for: multi-gig LAN without an extra switch
